userStories.title: YJ_MORE drive stability: prevent repeated disconnect/fallback cycles
userStories.description: YJ_MORE external drive disconnects repeatedly under normal use, triggering the reconcile agent to redirect home-dir symlinks (npm-cache, asdf, vscode, etc.) to empty internal fallback dirs, which rapidly fills the boot volume. Root causes to investigate: USB power management, macOS drive sleep policy, pmset keepawake, or a missing persistent mount strategy. Immediate fix (reconcile no-fallback for home-dir offloads) applied 2026-05-01.
acceptanceCriteria: Root cause of YJ_MORE disconnect identified (USB power, sleep policy, or hardware)
pmset or other system policy configured to prevent drive sleep on YJ_MORE
fleet.json external_hosts entry gains 'keep_awake: true' flag consumed by devdrive-automount
devdrive-automount adds keepalive touch/ping loop for external hosts flagged keep_awake
Reconcile log shows zero HOME OFFLOAD dangling events over 24h with YJ_MORE connected

userStories.title: Reconcile agent: skip fallback redirect for home-dir offload symlinks
userStories.description: When an external volume goes offline, the reconcile agent was redirecting ALL symlinks (including home-dir offloads like ~/.npm-cache, ~/.asdf) to empty internal fallback dirs. This caused silent internal disk writes filling the boot volume. Fix: for symlinks whose source path is outside ~/DevDrive/, leave them dangling rather than redirecting to fallback. Applied as a direct patch to devdrive-reconcile.sh on 2026-05-01.
acceptanceCriteria: devdrive-reconcile.sh logs HOME OFFLOAD dangling for home-dir symlinks when volume offline
No writes occur to ~/DevDrive/901DEVLIB-fallback/ for home-dir offload paths during offline
Internal disk usage does not spike when YJ_MORE disconnects
